title: Product ingredient link foundation
summary: 제품과 canonical ingredient의 사람 승인 대표 관계를 additive하게 잠그고, exact product/version identity를 보존한 DISTINCT effective-ingredient projection을 모든 required reader와 account-delete 경계에 적용한다.
goal: 제품으로 보관한 팬트리 항목도 승인된 대표 재료가 있을 때만 recipe recommendation과 후속 validation에서 같은 canonical ingredient로 인식되게 하되, 제품과 영양 version provenance는 잃지 않는다.

notes: PR #1076 records the Stage 1 contract and independent internal 1.5/security-DB/five-axis approvals at exact head f3d9be4e37bf791c430635036aa14bf355a7b85b. This relock updates the official tuple to v1.7.26/v1.5.30/v1.3.28/v1.3.27/v1.2.30 and replaces retired local-only verification with hybrid local application Data plus remote Auth exact-epoch/session evidence. F0 and recipe-visibility-read-hardening are merged predecessors, but production activation remains Manual Only. The current public pantry contract accepts ingredient_ids only, shopping rows lack product/version provenance, and pantry product/version FK delete behavior is not locked; pantry identity/projection and related readers remain unchecked pending approved Contract Evolution. A small first Stage 2 PR may implement only link authority, promotion ACL and a fail-closed eligible-link selector without changing pantry_items or public payloads. Workflow lifecycle remains planned until implementation begins.
